rationale: C05 is an unmistakable concrete drafting template. The child repeats nearly the entire recital and operative structure of C05, retains its earlier 25,000,000- and 60,000,000-pound authorizations in the amended subdivision, and adds a new 80,000,000-pound period. It also preserves the license waiver, identical 2,500,000-pound per-entity ceiling, and continuation pending Tariff Commission recommendations. C10 is the earlier source of the same subdivision and machinery, while C02 is a strong but less textually exact emergency dairy-quota precedent.
